## August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 258)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio and syndication, Bob Readick investigating telepathic conspiracies in *Dameron*, Jackson Beck narrating the Peabody Award-winning combat docudrama *The Man Behind the Gun*, and three multi-era installments of Carlton E. Morse's legendary *I Love a Mystery* (1939 Fleischmann's Yeast mystery, 1944 P&G Mexican occult thriller *The Temple of Vampires*, and 1950 Western desert manhunt *The Case of the Murder in Turquoise Pass*) (1939–1973):
